us_market.indices: Restore all existing canonical user-facing US major-index rows. At minimum validate current packet owners for SPY/QQQ/IWM if those are the canonical current rows; do not substitute proxies for a different pre-existing cash-index owner.
us_market.wti: Use the existing approved WTI source owner with provider-specific publication-lag semantics.
us_market.session_date: Normalize exchange observations to the actual exchange-local completed session date, not collection-host local date.
us_market.macro_publication: Freshness is evaluated against the expected publication date for that provider/series, including weekends and holidays.

sector_ranking.kr_taxonomy: Do not combine KOSPI and KOSDAQ taxonomies unless an existing canonical cross-venue sector owner explicitly makes them comparable.

night_futures.weekly: same selected contract, current calendar week through reference date, render IN_PROGRESS OHLC and included/expected sessions
night_futures.monthly: same selected contract, official history from month start through reference date, excluding future/non-session dates
night_futures.partial_rendering: Partial/in-progress aggregate OHLC may render; unavailable return must be labeled unresolved rather than collapsing the whole block to data-insufficient.
